section.content: 本发明提供了一种水性粘结剂及其应用，所述水性粘结剂包括儿茶酚羧酸类化合物改性的壳聚糖，所述儿茶酚羧酸类化合物包括左旋多巴、α‑甲基多巴、屈昔多巴、3,4‑二氢咖啡酸、二羟基桂皮酸、二羟苯乙酸、原儿茶酸、3,4‑二氢扁桃酸或大黄酸中的任意一种或至少两种的组合。本发明所述水性粘结剂具有良好的力学性能和湿态粘接能力，在硅负极体积变化时，能发挥优异的粘结作用，不会使体系开裂而导致掉粉的问题，能显著提升硅碳体系锂离子电池的容量和循环性能。

The invention provides an aqueous binder and application thereof, wherein the aqueous binder comprises chitosan modified by catechol carboxylic acid compounds, and the catechol carboxylic acid compounds comprise any one or combination of at least two of levodopa, alpha-methyldopa, droxidopa, 3, 4-dihydrocaffeic acid, dihydroxycinnamic acid, dihydroxyphenylacetic acid, protocatechuic acid, 3, 4-dihydromandelic acid or rhein. The aqueous binder disclosed by the invention has good mechanical property and wet-state binding ability, can play an excellent binding role when the volume of a silicon cathode changes, cannot crack a system to cause the problem of powder falling, and can obviously improve the capacity and the cycle performance of a silicon-carbon system lithium ion battery.

Aqueous binder and application thereofTechnical Field

The invention belongs to the technical field of batteries, relates to a water-based binder, and particularly relates to a water-based binder and application thereof.

Background

With the rapid development of new energy automobiles, the existing commercial anode and cathode materials can obviously not meet the requirements of lithium ion batteries on energy density, especially the actual specific capacity of the graphite anode material is close to the theoretical specific capacity, and the silicon anode material becomes the most promising next-generation lithium ion battery anode material due to the higher theoretical specific capacity (4200 mAh/g).

However, the great volume change of silicon in the process of lithium intercalation and deintercalation seriously affects the service life of the battery. The commercial mixing system of CMC (sodium carboxymethylcellulose) and SBR (styrene butadiene emulsion) and PVDF (polyvinylidene fluoride) as a binder obviously cannot play a good binding effect when the volume of a silicon negative electrode changes.

Based on the research, how to provide an aqueous binder can exert a better binding effect when the volume of a silicon cathode changes, remarkably improve the capacity and the cycle performance of a silicon cathode system lithium ion battery, and become a problem which needs to be solved urgently at present.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention aims to provide an aqueous binder and application thereof, and particularly relates to an aqueous binder for a silicon negative electrode and application thereof.

In order to achieve the purpose, the invention adopts the following technical scheme:

in a first aspect, the present invention provides an aqueous binder, the aqueous binder comprises chitosan modified by catechol carboxylic acid compound, and the structural formula of the aqueous binder is as follows:

wherein X is determined by catechol carboxylic acid compound;

the catechol carboxylic acid compound has the following structural general formula:

the catechol carboxylic acid compound comprises any one or a combination of at least two of levodopa, alpha-methyldopa, droxidopa, 3, 4-dihydrocaffeic acid, dihydroxycinnamic acid, dihydroxyphenylacetic acid, protocatechuic acid, 3, 4-dihydromandelic acid or rhein, and typical but non-limiting combinations comprise a combination of levodopa and alpha-methyldopa, a combination of droxidopa and 3, 4-dihydrocaffeic acid, a combination of levodopa and droxidopa, or a combination of protocatechuic acid and 3, 4-dihydromandelic acid.

When the catechol carboxylic acid-based compound is a combination of two compounds, the molar ratio of any two catechol carboxylic acid-based compounds is 1 (0.5 to 2.5), and may be, for example, 1:0.5, 1:1, 1:1.5, 1:2 or 1:2.5, but is not limited to the above-mentioned values, and other values not shown in the numerical range may be similarly applied.

Compared with the traditional adhesive, the aqueous adhesive disclosed by the invention has better adhesive strength, can play an excellent adhesive role when the volume of a system changes, cannot crack the system to cause the problem of powder falling, also can have good adhesive force in liquid, and keeps good adhesive stability of a negative electrode in electrolyte.

Preferably, the catechol carboxylic acid compound comprises any one of levodopa, alpha-methyldopa or dihydroxycinnamic acid or a combination of at least two thereof, typical but not limiting combinations include a combination of levodopa and alpha-methyldopa or a combination of dihydroxycinnamic acid and alpha-methyldopa, preferably dihydroxycinnamic acid.

Preferably, the weight average molecular weight of the aqueous binder is from 100000 to 1000000, which may be, for example, 100000, 500000 or 1000000, but is not limited to the values listed, and other values not listed within the numerical range are equally applicable, preferably from 200000 to 500000.

The preparation method of the water-based binder comprises the following steps:

mixing catechol carboxylic acid compounds and chitosan, reacting, dialyzing, concentrating and drying to obtain the aqueous binder.

Preferably, the mixing comprises dissolving the catechol carboxylic acid compound in a hydrochloric acid solution, and mixing the chitosan and the catalyst to obtain a dispersion liquid.

Preferably, the mass ratio of the chitosan to the catechol carboxylic acid compound is 1 (0.5 to 1.5), and may be, for example, 1:0.5, 1:1 or 1:1.5, but is not limited to the enumerated values, and other unrecited values in the numerical range are also applicable.

Preferably, the mass fraction of the hydrochloric acid solution is between 1 wt% and 5 wt%, and may be, for example, 1 wt%, 2 wt%, 3 wt%, 4 wt% or 5 wt%, but is not limited to the recited values, and other values not recited within the range of values are equally applicable.

Preferably, the content of the catechol carboxylic acid-based compound is 4 wt% to 6 wt%, for example, 4 wt%, 5 wt% or 6 wt%, based on the mass of the dispersion, but is not limited to the recited values, and other values not recited in the numerical range are also applicable.

Preferably, the mass ratio of the catechol carboxylic acid compound to the catalyst is 1 (0.1 to 0.3), and may be, for example, 1:0.1, 1:0.2 or 1:0.3, but not limited to the enumerated values, and other values in the range of the enumerated values are also applicable.

Preferably, the catalyst comprises 1- (3-dimethylaminopropyl) -3-ethylcarbodiimide hydrochloride and N-hydroxysuccinimide.

Preferably, the temperature of the mixing is from 20 ℃ to 30 ℃, for example, it may be 20 ℃, 25 ℃ or 30 ℃, but is not limited to the recited values, and other values not recited within the numerical range are equally applicable.

Preferably, the mixing time is 12h to 24h, for example 12h, 16h, 18h, 20h, 22h or 24h, but is not limited to the recited values, and other values not recited in the numerical ranges are equally applicable.

Preferably, the dialysis is carried out for a period of time of 3 days to 7 days, for example 3 days, 5 days or 7 days, but not limited to the recited values, and other values not recited within the numerical ranges are equally applicable.

Preferably, the means of concentration comprises rotary evaporation concentration.

In a second aspect, the present invention provides an anode comprising an aqueous binder as described in the first aspect.

When the aqueous binder is used as a binder of a silicon cathode, the volume of silicon can be changed in the process of lithium intercalation and deintercalation in the battery cycle process, and the aqueous binder has excellent mechanical property and wet-state binding capacity, so that the problem of cracking of the silicon cathode caused by the volume change can be avoided, and the capacity and cycle performance of the battery are improved.

Preferably, the active material layer of the negative electrode includes 5 parts to 15 parts by weight of the aqueous binder, for example, 5 parts, 10 parts, or 15 parts, but is not limited to the enumerated values, and other unrecited values within the numerical range are also applicable.

Preferably, the active material layer of the negative electrode further includes 80 parts to 90 parts by weight of a silicon-based material, for example, 80 parts, 85 parts, or 90 parts, but is not limited to the enumerated values, and other unrecited values within the numerical range are also applicable.

Preferably, the silicon-based material comprises any one of elemental silicon, a silicon oxy-compound or a silicon carbon material.

Preferably, the active material layer of the negative electrode further includes 5 parts to 10 parts by weight of a conductive agent, for example, 5 parts, 8 parts, or 10 parts, but is not limited to the enumerated values, and other unrecited values within the numerical range are also applicable.

Preferably, any one or a combination of at least two of the acetylene black, the conductive carbon black or the carbon nanotubes, and typical but non-limiting combinations include a combination of acetylene black and conductive carbon black, or a combination of acetylene black and carbon nanotubes.

In a third aspect, the present invention provides an electrochemical device comprising the negative electrode according to the second aspect.

Preferably, the electrochemical device comprises a lithium ion battery.

In a fourth aspect, the present invention provides an electronic device comprising an electrochemical apparatus according to the third aspect.

Compared with the prior art, the invention has the following beneficial effects:

the aqueous binder is obtained by modifying chitosan with catechol carboxylic acid compounds, has good mechanical property and wet-state binding capacity, can play an excellent binding role when the volume of a silicon cathode changes when being used as the silicon cathode binder, does not crack or fall powder of the silicon cathode, and can improve the capacity and the cycle performance of a silicon cathode lithium ion battery.

Detailed Description

The technical solution of the present invention is further explained by the following embodiments. It should be understood by those skilled in the art that the examples are only for the understanding of the present invention and should not be construed as the specific limitations of the present invention.

Example 1

The embodiment provides an aqueous binder, wherein the aqueous binder is levodopa modified chitosan, and the weight average molecular weight of the aqueous binder is 500000;

the preparation method of the water-based binder comprises the following steps:

dissolving levodopa in a hydrochloric acid solution with the mass fraction of 1 wt%, mixing with chitosan and a catalyst, mixing the obtained dispersion liquid at 25 ℃ for 12 hours, dialyzing for 3 days, performing rotary evaporation concentration and drying to obtain the aqueous binder;

the catalyst is 1- (3-dimethylaminopropyl) -3-ethylcarbodiimide hydrochloride and N-hydroxysuccinimide;

the levodopa content is 5 wt% based on the mass of the dispersion; the mass ratio of the chitosan to the levodopa is 1: 1.5; the mass ratio of the levodopa to the catalyst is 1: 0.2.

Example 2

The embodiment provides an aqueous binder, the aqueous binder is levodopa-modified chitosan, and the weight average molecular weight of the aqueous binder is 100000;

the preparation method of the water-based binder comprises the following steps:

dissolving levodopa in a hydrochloric acid solution with the mass fraction of 3 wt%, mixing with chitosan and a catalyst, mixing the obtained dispersion liquid at 30 ℃ for 16h, dialyzing for 5 days, concentrating by rotary evaporation, and drying to obtain the aqueous binder;

the catalyst is 1- (3-dimethylaminopropyl) -3-ethylcarbodiimide hydrochloride and N-hydroxysuccinimide;

the levodopa content is 4 wt% based on the mass of the dispersion; the mass ratio of the chitosan to the levodopa is 1: 0.5; the mass ratio of the levodopa to the catalyst is 1: 0.1.

Example 3

The embodiment provides an aqueous binder, wherein the aqueous binder is levodopa modified chitosan, and the weight average molecular weight of the aqueous binder is 600000;

the preparation method of the water-based binder comprises the following steps:

dissolving levodopa in a hydrochloric acid solution with the mass fraction of 4 wt%, mixing with chitosan and a catalyst, mixing the obtained dispersion liquid at 20 ℃ for 24 hours, dialyzing for 4 days, concentrating by rotary evaporation, and drying to obtain the aqueous binder;

the catalyst is 1- (3-dimethylaminopropyl) -3-ethylcarbodiimide hydrochloride and N-hydroxysuccinimide;

the levodopa content was 6 wt% based on the mass of the dispersion; the mass ratio of the chitosan to the levodopa is 1: 0.8; the mass ratio of the levodopa to the catalyst is 1: 0.3.

Examples 4 and 5 the same as in example 1 were conducted except that the kinds of catechol carboxylic acid-based compounds were changed as shown in Table 2 and the preparation method was changed.

Example 6 and example 7 the same as example 1 except that the mass ratio of chitosan to levodopa was changed as shown in table 3.

Comparative example 1 provides an adhesive that is commercially available PAA (polyacrylic acid).

Comparative example 2 provides a binder that is commercially available PVDF (HSV 900).

Comparative example 3 provides a binder, which is phenylacetic acid-modified chitosan, and has a weight average molecular weight of 500000;

the preparation method of the binder is the same as that of example 1 except that the raw material adaptability is changed.

Application examples 1 to 7 provide a negative electrode, in parts by weight, active material layers of the negative electrode respectively include 10 parts of acetylene black, 80 parts of a silicon carbon material, and 10 parts of an aqueous binder, and the aqueous binder is dissolved in water to obtain a 5 wt% aqueous binder solution for use; the aqueous binders in application examples 1 to 7 correspond to the aqueous binders provided in examples 1 to 7, respectively.

Application example 8 provides a negative electrode whose active material layer includes 5 parts by weight of carbon nanotubes, 90 parts by weight of a silicon carbon material, and 5 parts by weight of the aqueous binder described in example 1, respectively; the aqueous binder was dissolved in water to give a 5 wt% aqueous binder solution.

Application example 9 provides a negative electrode whose active material layer correspondingly includes, in parts by weight, 5 parts of acetylene black, 80 parts of a silicon carbon material, and 15 parts of the aqueous binder described in example 1; the aqueous binder was dissolved in water to give a 5 wt% aqueous binder solution.

Application examples 10 to 11 provide a negative electrode, and the rest was the same as in application example 1 except that the parts of the aqueous binder were changed and the parts of the acetylene black and the silicon carbon material were changed to make the total of 100 parts by weight as shown in table 4.

Comparative application examples 1 to 3 provide a negative electrode whose active material layers respectively include, in parts by weight, 10 parts of acetylene black, 80 parts of a silicon carbon material, and 10 parts of an aqueous binder dissolved in water to obtain a 5 wt% binder solution for use; comparative application examples the aqueous binders in comparative application examples 1 to 3 correspond to the aqueous binders provided in comparative examples 1 to 3, respectively.

And (3) performance testing:

the above application example and comparative application exampleThe provided negative electrode, the positive electrode, the diaphragm and the electrolyte are assembled into the soft package lithium ion battery according to the general process for preparing the soft package lithium ion battery; the positive electrode is obtained by coating and drying positive electrode slurry on a copper foil, wherein the positive electrode slurry comprises LNCM (LiNi) with the mass ratio of 95:3:2:400.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2) Acetylene black, polyvinylidene fluoride and N-methylpyrrolidone; the diaphragm adopts a polypropylene microporous membrane (Celgard-2400); the electrolyte adopts 1mol/L LiPF6EC + DMC + EMC (EC is ethylene carbonate, EMC is ethyl methyl carbonate, DMC is dimethyl carbonate, and the volume ratio of EC, DMC and EMC is 1:1: 1).

And (3) testing the cycle performance of the assembled soft package lithium ion battery: the battery performance test system (BTS05/10C8D-HP) of the Shenghong electric appliance component electric company Limited is adopted, the discharge capacity of the soft package lithium ion battery at 1C/1C cycle is divided by the discharge capacity at the first cycle by the 50 th discharge capacity, and the capacity retention rate after 50 cycles is obtained.

And testing the peel strength of the negative electrode: taking the rolled negative plate, and cutting; taking a flat thin steel plate, firstly pasting a piece of double faced adhesive tape (the length is longer than the test length of a sample, and the width is equal to that of a pole piece) at the center of the steel plate, flattening by force, ensuring that the double faced adhesive tape is tightly pasted at the center of the steel plate, uncovering the double faced adhesive tape, pasting the pole piece on the adhesive tape, arranging an upper clamp and a lower clamp on a tensile machine, inserting the steel plate pasted with the fixed pole piece into the lower clamp, and vertically fixing; and inserting the pole piece without the adhesive into the upper clamp for fixing, so that the pole piece attached to the adhesive paper and the pole piece fixed by the upper clamp form an angle of 180 degrees, fixing the test sample, and then starting the test to obtain the peel strength.

From tables 1 to 5, the following points can be seen:

(1) from application examples 1 to 11, the aqueous binder disclosed by the invention has good binding strength, can improve the capacity and cycle performance of a silicon-carbon system lithium ion battery, and solves the problem of cycle performance reduction caused by volume expansion cracking of a silicon negative electrode in a cycle process.

(2) As is clear from application example 1 and application examples 6 to 7, when the amount of levodopa is too small, the effect of the aqueous binder is reduced and the cycle performance of the obtained silicon-carbon-based lithium ion battery is reduced as compared with application example 1, and when the amount of levodopa is too large, the cycle performance of the silicon-carbon-based lithium ion battery is not significantly improved.

(3) As is clear from application example 1 and application examples 8 to 11, when the amount of the aqueous binder added to the silicon negative electrode is too small, the cycle performance of the obtained silicon-carbon lithium ion battery is reduced as compared with application example 1, and when the amount of the aqueous binder added to the silicon negative electrode is increased in this order, the cycle performance of the obtained silicon-carbon lithium ion battery can be improved, but when the amount of the aqueous binder added to the silicon negative electrode is increased to 18 parts outside the preferable range, the cycle performance is not improved as compared with 15 parts; therefore, on the premise of saving resources, the proper amount of the aqueous binder provided by the invention can be added to enable the aqueous binder to be matched with the conductive agent and the silicon-carbon material to play an optimal role.

(4) As can be seen from the application example 1 and the comparative application example 2, compared with a silicon-carbon system lithium ion battery adopting a conventional binder, the cycle performance of the silicon-carbon system lithium ion battery adopting the aqueous binder is obviously improved; as is clear from application example 1 and comparative application example 3, the aqueous binder was modified chitosan, but was not modified with the catechol carboxylic acid compound of the present application, and the performance was significantly deteriorated as compared with application example 1.

In conclusion, the invention provides the aqueous binder and the application thereof, the aqueous binder is obtained by modifying chitosan with the catechol carboxylic acid compounds, has good mechanical property and wet-state binding capability, can play an excellent binding role when the volume of the silicon negative electrode changes, cannot crack the system to cause the problem of powder falling, and can remarkably improve the cycle performance of the silicon-carbon system lithium ion battery.

The above description is only for the specific embodiment of the present invention, but the protection scope of the present invention is not limited thereto, and it should be understood by those skilled in the art that any changes or substitutions that can be easily conceived by those skilled in the art within the technical scope of the present invention are within the protection scope and the disclosure of the present invention.
